description: FastAPI route handlers for customer-related API endpoints, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers, utilizing a customer service with an in-memory repository.

methods.name: list_customers
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all customers.

methods.name: get_customer_by_id
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a customer by ID.

methods.name: create_customer
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new customer.

methods.name: update_customer
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing customer.

methods.name: delete_customer
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a customer by ID.
